purpose: Acquire genuine case data and measure supported temporal/terrain quantities; validate accuracy only with compatible independent references

nepal.inputs: retained Sentinel1/2 candidates and historical OSM; new native GLO30 and historical NASADEM context

acquisition_limits.credentials: public account-free signing only; tokens are never persisted

urban.classes_are: annual model predictions, not independent reference labels

landsat.new_water_rule: MNDWI after>0 and before<=0, on common valid support
landsat.vegetation_loss_rule: NDVI_before>0.4 AND NDVI_after<0.2 AND NDVI_drop>=0.25; proxy only, not debris classification
landsat.threshold_selection: fixed before viewing case outputs; no metric-driven tuning

terrain.historical_terrain: NASADEM where accessible; neither model certifies event-time topography

reference_policy.EMSR927: all delivered areas treated as development/context, not strict untouched holdouts
reference_policy.EMSR049: pre-event reference base mapping, not flood truth
reference_policy.WorldCover: cross-product context only; v100/v200 method change confounds temporal comparison
reference_policy.JRC: historical water context, not event truth

experiment_policy: Run A-D only on compatible targets and common support; retain original22road diagnostic separately; report missing labels and abstentions instead of inventing IoU/F1
evidence_tracing_control: scripted source-support and tamper/unknown challenge set with and without provenance gate; zero human participant or productivity claim
publication: private local research release; no push or paper submission authorized
